نختلط (form VIII)
# نَخْتَلِطُ (naḵtaliṭu) /nax.ta.li.tˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَطَ (iḵtalaṭa)
# نَخْتَلِطَ (naḵtaliṭa) /nax.ta.li.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَلَطَ (iḵtalaṭa)
# نَخْتَلِطْ (naḵtaliṭ) /nax.ta.litˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِخْتَلَطَ (iḵtalaṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
